g.text: TDK Lifecycle v5 - Project Start to Retro Learning
Current baseline: greenfield/brownfield setup -> guarded settings -> epic decomposition -> child build -> memory sync -> approved learning loop
Greenfield/brownfield intake sets authority; settings change only through reviewable proposals and guarded apply.
Use this rail only when the work is broad enough to need product alignment and child slice seeds.
One selected child seed or small feature becomes the requirement authority, then a routed implementation plan.
Only durable domain/project knowledge enters memory. New domains require init/domain setup first.
Collect evidence, propose deltas, apply only user-approved changes, then feed future sessions.
Optional: dependency policy -> golden-path scaffold -> sub-workspace docs -> automation
Optional: /tdk-memory-changelog records staged memory changes before commit
